# Mosaic Database

Mosaic Database is managed PostgreSQL with instant branches, governed SQL over HTTP, and explicit replication and recovery boundaries.

- Website: https://database.mosaicos.com/
- DevDocs: https://database.mosaicos.com/docs
- Pricing: https://database.mosaicos.com/pricing
- Roadmap: https://database.mosaicos.com/roadmap
- Signup: https://database.mosaicos.com/start
- API: https://database-api.mosaicos.com/
- MCP manifest: https://database-api.mosaicos.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- Plans: Shared $100/month with 5 databases and 20 branches; Dedicated $500/month with 20 databases and 100 branches.
- Public self-serve signup accepts Shared only. Repeating signup for the same email rotates the tenant key and invalidates the old key.
- Query API: POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/databases/{database_id}/query.
- Governed SQL accepts one SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, WITH, VALUES, or SHOW statement, with plan-specific row and timeout limits.
- Databases have a main branch and can have child branches.
- Physical replication is asynchronous. Standbys use hot_standby=off and are dark, not read endpoints.
- Promotion is operator-triggered; there is no automatic failover.
- Replication is not a backup. PITR and WAL archiving are future work.
- A global database ceiling defaults to 50 and returns 503 at capacity.
